summary: The four closed O normal-input results are internally consistent and independently reproducible from archived distances and dataset filename GT. All 72 immutable request hashes match; 498 intake files, 97 source bindings, four raw archives, 200 epochs and 15126 formal update records reconcile. No blocking integrity discrepancy was found. Benchmark-based checkpoint selection, one expert seed on one frozen teacher seed, unequal original-versus-expert total training budget and dormant historical evaluation paths limit claims. Both weak-dataset normal mAP/Rank-1 +1 goals are unmet.

details: GT identities, cameras and scenes are parsed from dataset filenames. No retrieval GT is generated from embeddings, contribution predictions or model-ranked references.

Independent reviewer code parsed every train/query/gallery manifest filename, verified disjoint training/test identity sets and training label mappings, and matched all archived query/gallery metadata. Counts are MSVR310 1032/591/1055 and RGBNT100 8675/1715/8575.

Ranking excludes same identity AND same scene for MSVR310; same identity AND same camera for RGBNT100. Every selected query has at least one retained relevant gallery item: 591/591 and 1715/1715 per arm.
The model-derived stopped-gradient contribution targets are explicitly auxiliary training proxies; they do not replace dataset labels or define AP/INP ground truth.

B.scope: Raw mAP, mINP and Rank-1/5/10/20, CMC1-50, per-query and grouped results for closed O normal input; arithmetic consistency of the two baseline and four N reference readouts used in comparisons.
details: AP averages precision at GT-relevant ranks; INP is relevant count divided by last relevant rank; rank indicators are averaged over valid dataset queries and multiplied by 100. No reported retrieval score is divided by a model maximum, prediction mean or a control's own score.
L2 descriptor normalization is representation normalization, not performance-score rescaling. All six metrics come from one distance matrix and one GT mask.

Independent CPU sorting of all four SHA-verified NPZ distance matrices reproduced 4612 selected-query records with zero AP/INP error. Raw recount six-metric error versus independent CSV reduction is 0; cross-format floating-point differences are at most 1.4210854715202004e-14 percentage points for selected results.

All 200 epoch per-query CSVs were reduced independently: 230600 rows, maximum epoch metric discrepancy 2.842170943040401e-14 percentage points. The ten selected readouts' CMC50/groups and all 12 comparison rows / 13836 paired-query changes were reconciled.
Contribution loss and the zero-prediction loss are raw training diagnostics. They are not a benchmark score, evidence of calibrated confidence, or a causal effect.

The +1 normal-input performance goal is not achieved on either weak dataset. This negative scientific result is retained and is not an integrity failure.

E.scope: Closed normal-input scope, full official split eligibility, paired control budget/sampling, seed/teacher disclosure and boundaries on subsequent missing-input claims.
details: The four O runs cover two datasets, one ordinary-frequency/axis pair per dataset, expert seed42 on the frozen original DeMo seed42 teacher. No fresh RGBNT201 O training, multi-seed replication or complete-pipeline repeat is established.

Full official training eligibility and all query/gallery records are used. Every training name is visited across the 50-epoch campaign; P8K8 sampling does not imply each record appears in every epoch. There is no artificial fit/dev training identity holdout.

The ordinary and axis O arms have identical serialized configuration, P8K8 batch name/order/partial-set sequences, counts of active and total parameters, dimension5120 and stage updates. Their sequences also match the corresponding N arms exactly.

Original DeMo50 and frozen-teacher50 plus fresh-expert50 have different total training budgets and original samplers: MSVR310 original705 updates versus new1000; RGBNT100 original6357 versus new6563. A fair same-budget comparison is O axis versus O frequency, not a claim that original and O consumed equal training compute.
All checkpoints are chosen by highest official normal benchmark mAP among 50 epochs. This is disclosed benchmark selection and cannot substantiate an untouched-test generalization claim.

Ordinary/axis comparisons are mixed: MSVR axis minus frequency is -0.015128011806986308 mAP / +0.16920473773264888 Rank-1; RGBNT100 is +0.1701014275157604 / -0.23323615160350641. Both weak-dataset axis-versus-original +1 goals are false.

Missing-modality and selected-gradient stages are outside this normal-only audit. Their absence from this request is not evidence of failure or success; no normal closure receipt certifies their completion.
